sens_en: to bank up, to cultivate, to train
origine_fr: La terre 土 et 咅, écrit 立 sur 口. On amasse la terre au pied des plantes : butter, puis cultiver, former. 咅 (pǒu) ne donne pas le son de péi.
origine_en: Earth 土 and 咅, written 立 over 口. Soil is heaped around the foot of plants: to bank up, then to cultivate, to train. 咅 (pǒu) does not give the sound of péi.
